status: internal candidate; not a runtime service or host capacity guarantee
admission: atomic resource reservation for the sealed fresh cohort before any member host dispatch
reservation: per-root bounded work envelope plus protected cleanup headroom; shared execution exit reserve
exclusive: reserve exact provider-resolved binding identities; conflicts reject, never queue or serialize
effects: existing cumulative admissions remain spent; reserve future child admissions without counting them as executed
refund: per dimension, only against qualified capacity evidence; never infer from effect settlement or a zero counter
unknown: retain charged capacity and exclusivity until execution teardown; no in-execution reconciliation in v0
finish: release unused work/future-effect promises; surviving result/unresolved charges and required cleanup headroom remain execution-owned carry
limits: provider profile supplies explicit supported ceilings and provenance; missing or unbounded demand rejects
